definition: A book generated for each style from its records: its constraints, the variants it forbids, the named errors with their exceptions, its proportion packs, and its orders and details drawn, in a form that can be read or printed.
basis: Our wording of designed work, drawn from what the corpus says of it. README.md: "Generated guidelines and details, and costs"; VISION.md, of what leaves the system: "generated from the data rather than written, so they cannot drift from it".
